name: Regional official city limits and approximate area point markers

metadata.description: Official California city/town-limit geometries for incorporated places, plus approximate point markers for unincorporated mountain areas that do not have city limits.
metadata.officialSource: California City Boundaries and Identifiers, CDTFA/California State Geoportal, queried with OFFSHORE IS NULL and outSR=4326.
metadata.simplification: Official city/town-limit geometries simplified with Douglas-Peucker tolerance 0.0006 degrees for browser rendering; approximate unincorporated areas are point markers.
metadata.peninsulaCoverage: Incorporated cities from San Francisco through San Jose on the Peninsula/South Bay side.
